message.content: Ending my turn and holding onto my cash. I have $54, and every property I could mortgage is still earning rent, so I'll only mortgage something if I have to cover a bill. The next roll is risky: it could land me on p1's hotels or p4's houses.
message.reasoning:
With only $54 in cash, I'm worried about landing on the expensive hotels or three-house properties nearby — Oriental, Vermont, and Connecticut are all reachable with rolls of 2, 4, or 5 from my current spot on Income Tax, and any of those could bankrupt me.

Then again, I do have the yellow monopoly with Atlantic, Ventnor, and Marvin Gardens, though no houses built yet since I lack cash to build. Trading isn't promising either since the other player only has $26 and a couple weak properties, so I'll just end my turn and mortgage something only if I'm actually forced to pay.

function.name: end_turn
function.arguments: {"public_message": "Tax paid. Dark blues stay loaded. Your move."}
